A rich, creamy holiday drink made from milk, eggs, and sugar, often spiced with nutmeg. Eggnog is sweet and comforting, but its festive charm is enhanced when spiked with alcohol, leading to warmth—and potential overindulgence.
A festive cold snap is freezing the region.

An unusual cold snap has set in.\n\nCold snaps can quickly kill by hypothermia. Be sure to build a heated space to survive, wear appropriate apparel, and try to harvest crops before they freeze and die.

questDescription->A festive aerodrone has been detected in orbit, carrying a shipment of presents. You've acquired the means to redirect it, causing it to crash at [map_definite].

When it crashes, the aerodrone will eject numerous presents into the air, scattering them across the area. Quickly collect them before they are lost or destroyed. [raidsDescription]

The aerodrone's remains will self-destruct in [destroyDelayTicks_duration], leaving nothing behind.

questDescription->A jolly aerodrone laden with presents has been detected in orbit. With the right codes, you can redirect it to crash at [map_definite].

Upon impact, the drone will scatter its precious cargo of presents across the area. Gather them quickly before they are claimed by others or destroyed. [raidsDescription]

Be aware that the aerodrone’s wreckage will self-destruct in [destroyDelayTicks_duration].

questDescription->A festive delivery drone carrying a shipment of gifts has been located. You can use a special code to force it to crash at [map_definite].

When it crashes, a burst of presents will rain down over the area, ripe for collection. Secure as many as you can before danger arrives. [raidsDescription]

The drone wreckage will obliterate itself in [destroyDelayTicks_duration].

questDescription->You've intercepted a signal from a holiday aerodrone packed with presents. Redirect it to crash at [map_definite] and claim the bounty of scattered gifts it will eject upon impact. [raidsDescription]\n\nHurry, as the drone’s remains will self-destruct in [destroyDelayTicks_duration], leaving nothing behind.

questDescription->An orbiting aerodrone brimming with festive presents has been detected. Using your codes, you can cause it to crash at [map_definite], releasing a cascade of gifts into the air. Collect them quickly and prepare for potential trouble. [raidsDescription]\n\nThe drone wreckage will destroy itself in [destroyDelayTicks_duration].

Santa knows that festive season is important. He will ensure that the story during the festive season is that of calm, joy and peace, and will start letting hell loose the further you are from the 10th of Decembrary. By doing good deeds, you will gain festive favor, which will be translated into rewards on the Christmas day.

A person-sized piece of material sculpted into an artistic form, depicting a festive father keeping a watchful eye. Placing all pieces of the festivity scene next to each other is bound to greatly increase their beauty.

A wall-mounted string of lamps that light up a small area using electricity. It is much less powerful than a standing lamp, but can be mounted on walls.

A classic music-playing device equipped with colorful lights and a selection of timeless festive tracks. Even on the rimworlds, a jukebox can fill the room with lively tunes or jolly melodies to lift the spirits.

A grand, carefully decorated tree with hundreds of ornaments, chains of lamps and tinsels. Lights up a large area. In Decembrary, grand festive trees contribute towards festive favor greatly, and depending on their quality, generate less or more festive favor every day. It takes a long time to construct a grand festive tree, but once built, decorations can be changed at will.
A festive present. Depending on the quality, it may contain valuable items or resources, or complete garbage.

A crashed variant of an aerodrone that ships presents across the planet. All the presents have been destroyed upon crashlanding, but it might be possible to obtain some festive crackers upon deconstructing this wreck. This wreck seems to emit some festive music, and due to some psychic influence, spreads snow around itself.

A portable automatic snowball propelling turret. Requires snow to be delivered to it after heavy use. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.

A portable automatic snowball propelling turret. Requires snow to be delivered to it after heavy use. May explode when damaged. Its dumb AI brain can't be directly controlled, so beware of friendly fire.

A heavy automatic snowball-firing cannon. The sheer amount of snowballs fired will cover a small area in devastating white volley, but it needs to be regularly reloaded with snow to continue firing. It cannot fire at close-up targets, and may explode when damaged.

A heavy automatic snowball-firing cannon. The sheer amount of snowballs fired will cover a small area in devastating white volley, but it needs to be regularly reloaded with snow to continue firing. It cannot fire at close-up targets, and may explode when damaged.
A person-sized sculpture out of snow, representing an artistic form of a human being. Whilst it will melt in the summer, it will continuously provide festive favor as long as it’s kept ‘alive’.

An advanced climatic manipulator designed for environmental transformation. By extracting atmospheric moisture and seeding it with ultra-cold nano-crystals, the snow spewer blankets entire regions with continuous snowfall, turning any landscape into a frozen wonderland.
A small, decorative tree with a number of festive lights that light up an area. People need light to move and work at full speed.
Sweet and tasty and bound to make anyone happy, this dessert has a tendency to disappear on the morning of December 10th. Fear not, however, as when it disappears, it increases festive favor greatly.
A small package of plastic waste and candy. When pulled apart, sprays confetti, bringing festive joy to everyone.
A comforting and creamy beverage offering a rich chocolate flavor that warms both body and soul. Perfect for cold days or as a delightful treat, it’s a simple yet indulgent classic.
Sweet and spicy gingerbread. Can be consumed raw or added as an ingredient in meals, but can also be used to construct sturdy objects with high beauty value.
Compressed frozen water crystals that can be shaped into sturdy structures that will melt and disappear in heat.

A small plushie toy. When carried by children, helps them create long lasting memories. The impact that such a toy can have depends on the quality of its craftsmanship. It is also widely known that donating toys to those in need is a very festive thing to do.

A small metal toy. When carried by children, helps them create long lasting memories. The impact that such a toy can have depends on the quality of its craftsmanship. It is also widely known that donating toys to those in need is a very festive thing to do.

A warm, fluffy, thick cap. Ideal for keeping warm in winter.
A cozy, thick and fluffy jacket for staying warm even in the coldest of temperatures.
A variant of an aerodrone that ships presents across the planet.
A festive rug with a wintery pattern, for decorating a floor.
A festive rug with a wintery pattern, for decorating a floor.
A spicy-sweet root with a warm, festive aroma. Ginger root thrives only in the chill of Decembrary and is the key ingredient for creating delicious gingerbread treats.
A tall conifer with dark green needles and densely packed branches. Its slender, conical shape is ideal for cold, snowy climates.
A majestic evergreen with soft, flat needles and smooth bark. Its symmetrical silhouette is often admired in alpine forests.
A hardy evergreen shrub or small tree with spiky needles and aromatic berries. It thrives in rocky, arid landscapes.

A colossal, herd-dwelling herbivore adapted to the harshest cold environments. The megareindeer boasts enormous, intricately branched antlers used for both display and defense. Originally engineered for arctic survival, it serves as a robust pack animal, capable of carrying heavy loads across frozen landscapes. Its thick, insulated fur is prized for crafting warm clothing. Generally docile, the megareindeer will fiercely maul enemies with its massive antlers if threatened.
